title: GM baseline and first campaign handoff walkthrough
selected_by_owner: Owner-directed GM build-order registration and read-only GM-00 product baseline, November 19, 2026.

ordered_steps.scope: Baseline the normal GM entry and existing workbenches. Record reachable, local/workbench and design-only surfaces. Define one reusable GM/player scenario and evidence log.
GM home, campaign create/open, basic campaign setup, roster, invites and roles. Connect the submitted character to the campaign and expose review, return and approval.

Minimum Session Planner and Scene Builder. Save and resume a draft with an ordered run sheet, one location, reusable actors and a hazard or clue. Attach or configure a minimal encounter, preview as the player and launch.
ordered_steps.delivery_home: A5/F005 and minimal PCV-04 prep integration

ordered_steps.scope: Live GM screen and ruling loop. Show scene, players, pending requests, private notes, quick rules and controls. Receive sheet rolls, checks, attacks, defend/reactions and active effects. Approve, deny, return or modify. Record GM-only and player-visible results.

Encounter Builder essentials and Combat controls. Set teams, goals, starting positions, waves, hazards, rewards and a reusable template. Run initiative, NPCs, targets, actions, reactions, conditions and combat close.

Run noncombat. Add clue and reveal controls, objectives, social checks, NPC knowledge, relationships, faction changes, clocks, travel/exploration and downtime. Move between Free/Downtime and Combat in the same session.
ordered_steps.delivery_home: PCV-05, A9, APW and existing domain owners

ordered_steps.scope: Finish the evening. Session pause/resume, checkpoint, closeout, private/shared recap, awards, campaign timeline and advance to the next session. Add GM-relevant scheduling, readiness and between-session links through MTLC.

Shared assets and economy. Party inventory, loot, trade, credit ledgers, shared permissions, crafting, downtime queues and facilities. Add campaign-owned fictional games/wagering under its existing PCV scope.
ordered_steps.delivery_home: PCV-06, A8/D17, GPR patterns and governed economy

ordered_steps.scope: Land vehicle, ship and mecha builder. Pick or create a chassis, configure slots, components, crew stations, cargo, system limits and cost, then validate, save, clone and instantiate. Reuse governed chassis and parts definitions.
ordered_steps.delivery_home: PCV-06 operational builds, MRCS-13/OARC. Reusable catalog authoring in PCV-07.

ordered_steps.scope: Live vehicle controls. Board and assign stations. Operate a mounted system, move, attack or defend, spend fuel or power, apply component damage, and hand off control. Carry state through Combat, Free/Downtime and Vehicle.

Full campaign-local prep. Expand encounters with balance estimates, simulation and reusable drafts. Add adventure and quest branching, maps/zones, World/setting tools, NPC/creature building, traps, journals, handouts, rewards and session recipes.
Creator authoring and sharing. Add house-rule overlays, reusable mechanical and lore objects, pack dependencies, validation, version history, import/export, review and private sharing.
ordered_steps.delivery_home: PCV-07 and governed publishing/Library; GATE for entitlement plumbing

ordered_steps.scope: Bring extension tools into real GM workflows where supported. Cover scene audio/cues, world intelligence, ambient patterns, organizations, spatial tools, async GM inbox, optional AI and AutoGM. Finish search, decisions, accessibility, responsive layouts and diagnostics across the GM workflow.
Certify one installed two-human campaign end to end from fresh setup to the next session.

in_scope: Map the normal GM and player entry routes and reusable local workbenches.
Exercise the available character-builder sample and locate the campaign submission handoff.
Run the normal GM/player walkthrough when an approved runnable target is available, logging the first failing step and exact evidence.
Deliver standalone GM workflow playtest increments as self-contained HTML files. Record feedback for the next cycle.
boundaries: Preserve existing campaign, session and character authority.
Respect PCV-03F and later PCV sequencing for installed/product work.
Standalone HTML is synthetic local playtest evidence. Product integration and installed shared-session results retain their existing acceptance boundaries.

first_unresolved_blocker: No runnable approved GM/player product target for the audited heads was available in this environment. The product is private, no local app checkout or scoped installer was available here, the repository lists no releases, and the shared installed boundary is still pending PCV-03F certification. The standalone playtest is available as a file, but this executor's Chromium exits at Unix socket initialization (Operation not permitted); its local JavaScript boundary was exercised in Node.
